dialog: I won't just stay on the back foot forever!
Some things need to be fought for.
I can't afford to back down.
If I'm going to fight/ I'll at least make it painless...
It's my turn to attack.
If you're prepared/ then here I come.
For everyone who lives in Gensokyo...
I'll really have to give this my all...
I haven't lost just yet...
Light!
Stay still.
I hope this makes them leave!
Take this!
Want a peek at a god's power?
You're done having your way here.
I have to do something...
The benediction of Makai's god...
be upon all living creatures.
Come/ everyone...
May repose and guidance...
be with all lost souls.
Now go/ all of you.
It's time.
Open your eyes...
And lend me your strength.
With the power of my magic...
The chains of life spin/ unbroken...
Ain Soph Aur.
They are at once providence and strength...
...and give birth to all things.
All that is to be born shall be...
...and so life continues its eternal/ unbroken chain.
From nothingness to infinity...
...do I deliver it to you.
There's nothing to worry about.
A reading.
...I am the creator of Makai.
If you would say destruction and regeneration are the essence of creation...
Then may even destruction be in peace...
...and give birth to all things.
If you hear this prayer...
Then to all those who live in this world...
Your momentary repose...
Your pain/ your suffering...
Entrust them to me.
And/ for now/ rest.
I will expend my entire being...
...to do whatever I can...
for all you who live for the present.
You are not alone.
For now/ entrust it all to me...
...and sleep well.
for all you who live for the present.
May repose and guidance...
Your repose/ your rest...
Your hesitation...
Your suffering...
...For now/ consign them all to oblivion.
I'm pretty good at playing the waiting game.
Oh... Well.
I lost sight of them?!
That was supposed to be my role/ not yours...
Oh/ whatever am I going to do with you?
You can leave it to me!
I won't let you through.
I will protect you.
A god's protection is with you.
Stay close/ alright?
I'm right here with you!
There's nothing to fear.
I'm watching over you!
I'll give you a hand!
I'm giving it all I have too!
Let's get in sync with each other!
We can do this together!
How dare you harm Alice like that!
You really opened them up/ Alice.
I can handle the rest/ Alice!
You're not laying a hand on my daughter.
Alice/ look ooout!
Mom is right here with you/ Alice.
I'll do as you say/ Alice!
Let's fight together/ Alice!
How are things looking over there/ Alice?
I'll help you/ Alice!
I've been waiting for this moment for so long!
We're in perfect sync/ Alice!
We can do this together/ Alice!
How dare you harm Yumeko like that!
You really opened them up/ Yumeko.
I can handle the rest/ Yumeko!
You're not laying a hand on my daughter.
Yumeko/ look ooout!
I'll do as you say/ Yumeko!
Do the best you can/ Yumeko!
Let's press forwards/ Yumeko.
You know what to do/ right/ Yumeko?
I'll help you/ Yumeko!
We're in perfect sync/ Yumeko!
I'll give it everything I have too/ Yumeko!
We can do this together/ Yumeko!
How dare you hurt Medi like that!
I can handle the rest/ Medi!
You really did a good job/ Medi!
Medi/ look ooout!
I won't let you hurt Medi!
Medi/ how are things over here?
Let's fight together/ Medi!
There's nothing to be afraid of/ Medi.
I'll be with you/ Medi.
Where do you want to go/ Medi?
We're in perfect sync/ Medi!
Let's combine our strength/ Medi!
We can do this together/ Medi!
How dare you hurt Byakuren like that!
Leave the rest to me/ Byakuren.
Byakuren created an opening/ and I won't waste it.
Byakuren/ look ooout!
I won't let you hurt Byakuren!
I'll do as you say/ Byakuren!
I never thought I'd be able to fight alongside Byakuren!
Byakuren/ how are things over here?
I'll help you/ Byakuren!
Let's fight together/ Byakuren!
Let's muster everything we have/ Byakuren!
The two of us are in perfect sync/ Byakuren!
We can do this together/ Byakuren!
So even you have some humanity/ Yuuka...
Just leave the rest to me/ okay?
So even you miss chances to finish them off sometimes.
I know you're a fighter/ but don't go out too far!
I won't just sit back and watch this.
I'll be watching to make sure you don't go too far.
No scary magic/ please.
Now you're dragging me into your awful schemes...
No going off on your own!
I just have to do what you say/ right? Ugh.
Perfect sync...doesn't seem like an option here.
Let's give it everything...but not too much/ on your part.
Okay/ fine. Let's both get serious.
So even you have some humanity/ Mima...
Just leave the rest to me/ okay?
So even you miss chances to finish them off sometimes.
I know you're a fighter/ but don't go out too far!
I won't just sit back and watch this.
I'll be watching to make sure you don't go too far.
No scary magic/ please.
Now you're dragging me into your awful schemes...
No going off on your own!
I just have to do what you say/ right? Ugh.
Perfect sync...doesn't seem like an option here.
Let's give it everything...but not too much/ on your part.
Okay/ fine. Let's both get serious.
This is getting more and more difficult...
Are they driving me back?
Could you stop bothering me?
I can't let myself fall here.
Hey! That hurt/ you know!
I can't lose focus!
Whoopsies. What should I do?
Yumeko is going to get angry with me now...
They found an opening?
Ouch!
This is nothing!
I can sense your resolve.
I'm not going to lose!
I can handle a wound like this...
You're really trying your best/ aren't you?
Hey/ I did a good job!
I can't exactly let you win/ can I?
Be careful of stray bullets/ okay?
I can tell where you're moving.
I didn't even flinch!
Hmm? Is that it?
No need to try—it won't work.
It will take more than that for me to let you through.
I am still a god/ you know.
You'll need to try harder than that to reach me!
Mmph!
Oh/ I knew you'd be coming from that direction.
I can't believe they fought me off...
B-But whyyy?!
Let's leave the fighting at that/ okay?
That one hurt... I don't want anyone to keep going if things get too dangerous!
What a terrible aura...
This just goes to show what good children they all really are.
I have everyone else to thank that Byakuren didn't end up like this.
I don't want to see Byakuren like this...
I will never back down against scoundrels like you!
I didn't think you would try to bar our way so persistently...
Mehko/ please don't force yourself. For everyone's sake.
If there's no choice but to fight/ then...
I guess this shows how determined you are...
Please/ stop! Nobody will benefit from this!
If there's no choice but to fight/ then I will never falter.
You're very powerful/ yes/ but...
For peace in Gensokyo/ I will devote all my strength...
If there's no choice but to fight/ then I will never falter.
You're very powerful/ yes/ but...
For Makura/ I will devote all my strength...
How dare you interrupt Alice's party!
You're far too at-home in Alice's house!
